newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Babcock restructures textile machines.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Babcock restructures textile machines.

text.p: The Deutsche Babcock group is restructuring its textile machinery business.
Moenus AG, which is 72 percent owned by Deutsche Babcock-Borsig AG, said on Wednesday it plans to take over Babcock Textilmaschinen GmbH from Babcock-BSH AG.

With losses estimated at half of its 47.8 million marks in capital, Moenus will also undergo a one-for-three capital cut to 15.9 million marks, followed by a rebuilding of its capital to 36 million marks.

The new five-mark face-value shares should be priced at 10 marks. The capital-building measures should bring in about 40 million marks, which will be used to finance the purchase of Babcock Textilmaschinen.
The measures will be put to a vote at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting in late October or early November.
